definitions: Engaged in a series of small tasks or activities without any particular urgency or purpose.
Spent time in a relaxed and unhurried way, doing pleasant but unimportant things.
examples: She pottered about in the garden all afternoon.
He pottered about the house, tidying up a bit.
They pottered about the shops, not really buying anything.
pastTenses: pottered about (past simple), pottered about (past perfect)
